newsitem.title: USA: Amerco reaches final holder settlement.
newsitem.headline: Amerco reaches final holder settlement.

text.p: AMERCO Inc said on Tuesday that it acquired 4,036,304 shares of common stock for $27.4 million from Michael Shoen and Mickl Inc in a final settlement of a shareholder dispute.
The stock purchase and other payments were made as a result of a settlement of various disputes between Shoen family members and AMERCO's board of directors, AMERCO said.

In connection with the purchase, AMERCO also paid Shoen, the son of U-Haul founder L.S. Shoen, approximately $74.8 million. AMERCO said it has purchased 18.2 million, or 47.3 percent of its shares since the settlment process began.
A spokesman for Amerco said Shoen family members received a total of $461.8 million under the settlement.
